newsitem.title: USA: MTR unit gets $11.1 mln loan.
newsitem.headline: MTR unit gets $11.1 mln loan.

text.p: MTR Gaming Group Inc said on Friday that its Mountaineer Park Inc has received a $11.1 million loan made by the New York lending firm that provided Mountaineer a $5 million second mortgage loan in July.
Proceeds repaid an $8.7 million balance on a construction loan that would have led to a penalty if it were not paid by January 1, 1997.
The total loan of $16.1 million is now secured by a first mortgage on Mountaineer's racetrack and resort, MTR said.

MTR said it has agreed to issue the unnamed lender over a period of 13 months 550,000 shares of the company's stock and warrants to purchase 1,632,140 additional shares at $1.06 per share, pending state regulatory approval.
If the loan is prepaid by July 1, 1997, a cash fee of eight points will be waived, as well as annual fees of cash, stock, and warrants, MTR said.

Also, annual fees with respect to the $5 million loan made in July have been deferred from July 2 to November 15, 1997, MTR said. The lender also provided Mountaineer a $5,376,500 revolving credit line, MTR said.
In connection with the line of credit, the company has agreed to pay an annual fee of $376,500, the first of which is payable over 13 months.

Proceeds of the loan will be used to improve the Mountaineer Park property, including construction of a convention facility, a lodge, a bowling alley, additional video lottery machines, and a broadcast production facility, MTR said.
The company said the loan arrangement will give it more time to secure conventional financing without fees.
